title: Subarrays with sum k
statement:
Count the contiguous, non-empty subarrays of an integer array whose elements add up to exactly k.

Input: the first line holds n and k (1 <= n <= 100000, -10^9 <= k <= 10^9). The second line holds n integers a1 .. an separated by spaces (-10000 <= ai <= 10000).

Output: one line with the number of subarrays a[i..j] (1 <= i <= j <= n) whose sum is k. The answer can exceed 2^31, so use a 64-bit integer. An O(n^2) solution is too slow for the largest tests.

Example
Input:
5 3
1 2 1 -1 3
Output:
5
(The subarrays are [1 2], [2 1], [1 2 1 -1], [1 -1 3] and [3].)
